live_adapter_requirements: Discover and validate actual tools and their input/output schemas before binding search/fetch intents.
Use tenant-approved identity and source authorization; deny access if effective permissions cannot be established.
Never copy the synthetic fixture's public scope onto real documents.
Fetch full authorized content before indexing; search snippets and truncated tool output are incomplete evidence.
Preserve native IDs, original URL, source revision, source update time, extraction completeness and retrieval time separately.
Keep credentials in approved secrets; do not publish tool traces or private source payloads.
No source mutation tools are needed to answer QE questions.
